prompt: Send cleaner1 from dock_2 to the lobby at 23:00, then to the hall at 01:00, and back to dock_2.
why: The night clean crosses midnight: 01:00 is on the next calendar day. A time literal means that time on the day the task starts (0042 T4) and a run never reads past the end of that day (`S238`), so the second wait cannot be written (language reference: 'Clock readings'). The 23:00 part alone is the 1.9 program `f_clock_clean_at_2300`.
